title: Jet Streams in One Minute

endcard.line: Footage: Thomas Bresson (CC BY 3.0). Picture: NASA, ISS crew photograph (public domain)

segments.say: About ten kilometres above your head, there are rivers of wind, moving faster than a train. They're called jet streams.

anim.title: A jet stream
items: A narrow band of fast wind

segments.say: A jet stream is a narrow band of very fast wind near the top of the lower atmosphere. It forms where warm and cold air meet, and the bigger the difference, the faster it blows.
Over India, the westerly jet blows faster in winter than in summer, at well over a hundred and fifty kilometres an hour.

anim.title: Winter
items: The westerly jet sits south of the Himalayas
It carries western disturbances into India

segments.say: In winter, the subtropical westerly jet runs just south of the Himalayas. It brings in the western disturbances that give the north its winter rain.

anim.title: Early summer
items: The westerly jet jumps north of the Himalayas
An easterly jet forms over the peninsula

segments.say: By early June, the westerly jet shifts north of the Himalayas, and an easterly jet appears over the peninsula. Many scientists link this switch to the sudden burst of the monsoon.
Pilots use jet streams too. Flying with one saves fuel; flying against it takes longer.
For GS One: the westerly jet brings winter rain; its move north, and the easterly jet, are tied to the monsoon.

sources: NCERT Class 11, India: Physical Environment, ch. 4 (Climate): subtropical westerly jet south of the Himalayas in winter, bringing western disturbances; shifts north of the Himalayas in summer; tropical easterly jet over the peninsula in June; jet stream speeds of about 110 km/h in summer and 184 km/h in winter
NCERT Class 11, Fundamentals of Physical Geography, ch. 10: jet streams are narrow belts of high-altitude westerly winds in the troposphere, caused by temperature gradients

options: High up, near the top of the lower atmosphere
quiz.why: They blow about 9 to 12 kilometres up.

quiz.q: In winter, the westerly jet over India brings…
options: Cyclones in the Bay of Bengal
quiz.why: It runs south of the Himalayas and carries western disturbances in.

quiz.q: What happens to the westerly jet by early summer?
options: It moves north of the Himalayas
It moves to the Arabian Sea
quiz.why: Its shift north, with the easterly jet, is linked to the monsoon's onset.
